messages:
maya: heads-up: saw a couple of "ghost" config writes this morning where Console shows the override applied but the router agents kept using the old value. tenants noticed transient fallback routing. logs show `apply_id=ap-73456` then agents logged `reverted to v=2026-02-18T09:10:11Z`
julien: ugh. root cause? network partition when the config push happened?
maya: partly. turns out agents do an "operator merge" if they detect local ops locks. control-plane accepted the write (returned 200 + apply_id) but agents refused because of stale operator-lock token.
ops-bot: config-apply ap-73456 accepted by control-plane at 2026-03-20T14:12:05Z (apply_id=ap-73456)
tara: that mismatch is dangerous — app teams see success, but runtime never gets change. We need stronger client guarantees: at least return a post-apply confirmation when N agents ack.
ejan: +1 (typo: evan) i think we should avoid blocking synchronous apply on all agents, but we should offer an "apply-and-wait" mode with quorum acks and a non-blocking default.
evan: (fixed) yep. proposal: add `apply_mode` param: `fast` (current behavior) and `quorum` (wait for k-of-n agent confirmations). default remains `fast` to keep latency low. API: `POST /admin/configs/apply?mode=quorum&quorum=3`
julien: also need an idempotency and conflict token. currently we return `apply_id` but there's no etag. suggest we add `etag` on config resources and require clients supply `If-Match: etag` to avoid accidental overwrites.
tara: console UX: show a small banner when an apply is accepted but not yet confirmed by agents: "Pending confirmation (x/3 agents)" with link to pending apply details. Also queue of unconfirmed applies per-tenant.
maya: ops telemetry ask: emit `config.apply.ack` events with `apply_id`, `agent_id`, `result` and expose a drift metric `config.drift_pct` that counts mismatch between control-plane desired state and agent-reported state per-tenant.
ops-bot: added metric suggestion: `config.drift_pct` to infra.metrics.suggestions (id=cfg-989)
ejan: implementation detail: agents should attempt backoff retries and surface the reason for rejecting applies (e.g., operator-lock token expired). They should not silently merge and keep old values.
evan: agree. change behavior: agent will keep local operator lock semantics but must return explicit `reject_reason` to control-plane. control-plane to store last-reject and show in Console apply details.
julien: we also need a reconcile job that runs hourly and computes diffs, and opens a reconciliation ticket if drift_pct > 0.1% for 5m. It can also auto-schedule a reapply in `quorum` mode.
tara: security: when reapplying automatically, we must ensure secrets handling doesn't leak values to logs. reapply should use stored secret references, not raw strings.
evan: rollout plan: (1) add etag header and `If-Match` support (2) add apply_mode param with `quorum` path (3) return richer apply status with per-agent ack counts and reject reasons (4) console: pending applies UI + reconcile panel (5) a periodic reconcile worker + alerting.
julien: ETA: etag + api changes 2d, agent audit + explicit rejects 3d, console + reconcile worker 3d.
maya: for UX acceptance, demo flow: trigger an apply in `fast` mode (should return quickly), then trigger `quorum` mode and watch banner change from "pending" to "confirmed". also simulate operator-lock rejection to show helpful message: "operator lock held by team X until 2026-03-20T15:00Z"
ops-bot: runbook note: "If apply shows pending for >5min: check agent version and operator-locks; run reconcile job: POST /admin/reconcile?tenant=..." (link: https://runbooks.local/r/cfg-apply)
ejan: small API example for status: ```json
{ "apply_id":"ap-73456", "mode":"quorum", "acks": [ {"agent":"rtr-12","status":"ack"}, {"agent":"rtr-13","status":"reject","reason":"operator_lock:team-network"} ], "confirmed": false }
```
tara: question: should we auto-fence/lock during a `quorum` apply to prevent operators from grabbing locks mid-apply? might be heavy-handed.
julien: maybe instead surface a transient lock hint: control-plane can request a temporary coordination window and show it to operators. If operator tries to acquire a lock that collides with an in-flight quorum apply, they get a warning modal in Console.
evan: i'll prep a PR for the API + etag. tara will mock console banners. julien will change agent behavior to explicit reject reasons. maya will own reconcile worker and the metrics surface.
ops-bot: ticket created: INF-2077 "apply confirmation + etag + reconcile" (link: https://tracks.local/INF-2077)
maya: thanks all. this should reduce invisible rollouts and make ops debugging way easier. :white_check_mark:
